title: always keep wifi on during sleep Android 13
body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/2485
Originally posted by **master3395** November 21, 2022 Hello, i have noticed that with the latest Android 13 You will get annoying messages about enabling "always keep wifi on during sleep". But this option was removed after Android 12. (Not just Samsung like pointed out on the site below, I use OnePlus) https://eu.community.samsung.com/t5/galaxy-s21-series/wifi-keep-on-during-sleep-setting-missing-after-latest-update/td-p/5152555 This warning comes from time to time. I have given xDrip+ all perms that it asks for and more. ``` xDrip+ Version: 344deb4-2022.11.16 Code: 202211618 ``` ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4199669/202935185-98aa46e8-7b30-4e6c-b290-4afd5f59780d.png)

comments.body: This should be resolved in the Nov 27th nightly. Please confirm? thanks
